description: The plot illustrates the relationship between a numerical value on the x-axis and a value labeled “Missing Step” on the y-axis. The x-axis is labeled “Step” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 4, with tick labels at integer values. The y-axis is labeled “Missing Step” and has a linear scale ranging from approximately 0.844 to 0.860, with tick labels at intervals of 0.005. A dashed blue line with circular markers is present, starting at approximately 0.859 at x=0 and decreasing to approximately 0.844 at x=4; it exhibits a steady decline with data points at (1, 0.854), (2, 0.851), and (3, 0.848). An orange line with triangular markers is also present, beginning at approximately 0.856 at x=0, decreasing to approximately 0.848 at x=2, and then remaining steady at approximately 0.848 until x=4.
